upstream_api_review.spec_delta_from_previous_binding: Additive over 0.9.0-rc.24 (streamix_server#175, download permission and prefetch grants): the client subset grows from 118 to 120 operations and the full specification from 387 to 389; apart from info.version the client subset changes 28 places and the full export 55 (the other 27 are administration: library and user download settings, the DownloadDecision schema and administration descriptions, not published). New operations POST /prefetch/grants (sxapi_create_grant_post) and POST /prefetch/grants/{grant_id}/renew (sxapi_renew_grant_post) under the new player root /prefetch. New schemas PrefetchGrantRequest (additionalProperties false; required media_id, version_id, category detail|next_episode|cache|download and network lan|wan, recorded only), PrefetchGrantDecision (oneOf; approval and refusal are both 200, told apart by granted), PrefetchGrantApproved (grant_id; max_bytes 1048576..10737418240 for detail / next_episode, null for cache / download; max_seconds null; expires_at, the 10-minute start window; download only license_expires_at and renew_after) and PrefetchGrantRefused (reason disabled_globally|not_opted_in|user_not_allowed|library_not_allowed|prefetch_disabled|server_busy|rate_limited; retry_after_seconds with server_busy and rate_limited). A grant request is an ordinary request: one marked as a preload gets 403 prefetch_disabled or 429 prefetch_busy before the handler; 404 not_found and 400 are errors, not refusals; at most 30 grants per user per minute. Renewal re-runs the download decision for the caller's download grant (200 approval or refusal; 404 for another user's, an unknown or a no longer visible grant; 409 grant_not_renewable for other categories). GET and HEAD of /playback/sessions/{id}/stream and /playback/sessions/{id}/disc/files/{file_id} gain the optional STREAMIX-Grant header (exactly one UUID; 403 grant_invalid, grant_expired, grant_exhausted without Content-Range, prefetch_disabled, and the download refusals as error codes; detail / next_episode reads reserve bytes, cut a longer Range to the remaining budget as a shorter 206, serve a read without Range only when the whole file fits and take the preload lease outside the concurrent-stream limit whatever the User-Agent purpose; cache / download reads re-run the download decision and are not counted; 416 never signals a budget). The StreamixUserAgent description adds the purpose product Streamix-Download/1 for whole-file caching and downloads (never a preload; its stream reads re-run the download decision), ordered after Streamix-Play and Streamix-Preload. Capabilities features gain the required download_permissions (const true) and prefetch_grants (false in Nimbus private mode until the private runtime checks grants, while private stream reads check neither STREAMIX-Grant nor the download permission), and limits gain the required prefetch_max_bytes_ceiling (const 10737418240). In OPERATIONS.json only the two operations are added; typed_sdk_schema_sha256 is unchanged and check_sdk_contract passes. The Kit subset check adds the prefetch player root, matching the server's player roots.
